integrity_scope: size and mtime_ns stable across scan/sample export; a streaming SHA-256 was computed once.

source.format: ROS1 bag v2.0 / Orbbec SDK extended messages
source.duration_basis: Dynamic color/depth/IMU device timestamps. The epoch-stamped property topic must not extend sensor duration.

readable_stable_recording.detail: All indexed messages matched physical records. Source size/mtime stable.

usable_color_images.detail: All JPEG message envelopes checked; 26 selected payloads decoded at native 1280x720.

multiview_coverage.detail: Multiple visual views of the same scene, changing foreground occlusion and side visibility. Metric baseline and reconstruction coverage unknown.

sufficient_static_scene_content.detail: Tables and boxes recur as static background in the proposed segment. One sampled late frame includes a person. Quantitative static-scene coverage unknown.

camera_intrinsics.detail: One matching profile for each native image grid; intrinsics/distortion present.

usable_per_frame_camera_poses.detail: 0 / 11041 RGB poses. No TF, pose, odometry or world reference. IMU orientation all zero.

pose_frame_and_scale_consistency.detail: Local sensor transformations available in mm. World pose direction, scale and drift cannot be checked.

sensor_depth_present.detail: 11068 native depth frames; DEPTH/Y16 with disparity-to-depth enabled.

depth_encoding_decoded.detail: 26 native uint16 samples decoded with stride and endianness; four NPZ arrays compared against original pixels.

depth_unit_confirmed.detail: Property 176=1.0 mm/count; matching SDK and disparityParam.unit=1. Optical-axis Z.

rgb_depth_registration.detail: Native unregistered grids, hardware D2C disabled. Static depth-to-color calibration available, registration residual not measured.

temporal_association.detail: 11041 injective header/device matches within 10 ms. This measures frame time proximity.

dataset_conversion_requirements.detail: Need metric camera trajectory and validated RGB-grid depth. Fixed splits and conversion remain future work.
